html:
The Maji Maji rebellion was a rising against German rule in southern Tanganyika from 1905 to 1907, in which many different peoples fought together for the first time.

It began among farmers forced to grow cotton for the colony. The prophet Kinjikitile Ngwale gave fighters a sacred water, maji, which he said would turn German bullets into water. The rising spread across the south, but the water did not stop machine guns.

The Germans answered by burning villages and crops, and the famine that followed killed far more than the fighting, with estimates from about 75,000 to 300,000 dead. Germany then eased its rule in German East Africa. Julius Nyerere later saw the rising as a forerunner of the unity of Tanzania.
sum: The Maji Maji rebellion was a rising against German rule in southern Tanganyika from 1905 to 1907, in which many different peoples fought together for the first time.
